metadata.description:
A 6-step strategic planning workflow where a university cybersecurity
department seeks help creating a 3-year EU funding strategy. Tests the
system's ability to provide multi-programme strategic advice, suggest
logical application sequencing, and create realistic timelines. The
conversation builds user context progressively and validates that the
final strategy incorporates both Horizon Europe and Erasmus+ options
in a coherent multi-year plan.
